Members

pushGlitchRect

Pushes the session's cover-fit rect into the widget — device px, the same rect the 2D painters draw through, so frag→uv mapping reproduces object-fit: cover + object-position exactly.

  • @param s Live session with a mounted widget + measured rect.

uploadGlitchBitmap

Decodes the live portrait URL and uploads the bitmap to the widget — routed through decodeImageWASM so decode happens in the worker pool with GPU resize hints sized to the canvas's device-px box. Re-called on srcset drift (the browser swaps density candidates under a live session). A null bitmap or rejected upload kills the wasm arm and claims the 2D backend instead.

  • @param s Live session with a mounted widget.

tryGlitchWasm

Async mount — tries the rust/glitch artifact on the session canvas. On success the session's wasm field goes live and tick switches to frameGlitchWasm; on ANY failure (artifact, init, decode) the 2D backend is claimed — the session stays alive either way unless the 2D claim also fails, in which case the overlay is dropped and the plain is the final fallback.

  • @param host The component the session is parked on.
  • @param s Fresh session (ctx unclaimed, wasm null).

frameGlitchWasm

One wasm-backend frame — mirrors the 2D frame() clock (same 50ms dt clamp) so the roll-bar sweep pace matches either backend. Pushes the hover latch per frame (single f32 uniform — cheaper than edge-detecting it) and drops to the 2D backend if the surface reports itself stale.

  • @param s Live session with s.wasm non-null.
